faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Can't find your answer? Contact us or ask Droid on Telegram.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Browse the store here or in The IDEA app, then add items to your cart and check out in the app. You need The IDEA Pass to order.

items.question: How do I pay?
items.answer: Payments are processed securely by Wayl, which supports local payment methods. Your order is confirmed once the payment succeeds.

items.question: Where do you deliver?
items.answer: We deliver to all 19 governorates of Iraq. The delivery fee, if any, is shown at checkout before you pay.

items.question: Can I return an item?
items.answer: Yes, under the conditions in our refund and returns policy. Contact us from your order in the app or by email.

items.question: How does The IDEA Plus work?
items.answer: You subscribe to a monthly plan. Each plan lets you keep a number of items at a time. Request a game, book or movie in the app, we deliver it, and when you're done you return it and request the next one.

items.question: Can I buy from the Megastore without a membership?
items.answer: Absolutely. The Megastore is open to everyone; The IDEA Plus is only needed for rentals.

items.question: How do I cancel?
items.answer: You can cancel your membership from your account in the app. It stays active until the end of the period you paid for. Please return any rented items.

items.question: Do I need a separate account for each service?
items.answer: No. One account, The IDEA Pass, works across the store, The IDEA Plus, events, the journal and The IDEA Suite.

items.question: How do I delete my account?
items.answer: You can delete your account from the app's settings. Some records, such as invoices, are kept as the law requires.

items.question: How do I get help with an order or a rental?
items.answer: Sign in to The IDEA app and open a support ticket from the Support page. You can follow our replies there. Without an account, email hi@theideaiq.com or use the contact form.

plans.activeHint: Unavailable plans are hidden from new customers; current subscribers keep them.
plans.tierHint: 1 to 10; higher plans unlock items that need a higher tier. Required for The IDEA Plus.

orders.title: Orders
orders.fulfilmentHint: Move the order forward as it's prepared and delivered. Payments and refunds are recorded by the payment provider.

rentals.title: Rentals

empty.requests: No requests waiting to be delivered.
empty.history: No returned or cancelled rentals yet.

rentals.cancelDescription: The copy goes back into stock and the member's slot is freed.

customers.title: Customers
customers.tagsHint: Separate with commas, e.g. gamer, books.
customers.name: Name
customers.suspendDescription: They won't be able to order, rent, RSVP or submit work until the suspension is lifted.
customers.sortHint: Sorting by contact date lists customers with a CRM record only.
customers.lastContactedHint: Baghdad time. Leave empty if they haven't been contacted.

campaigns.subject: Subject
campaigns.segmentHint: Only customers who opted in to marketing email receive campaigns.
campaigns.bodyHint: Markdown. It's placed in The IDEA's email template with an unsubscribe link.
campaigns.previewHint: The saved version, as it will look in the email.
campaigns.sendDescription: It goes to: {audience}. Sending can't be undone.
campaigns.failedHint: Sending stopped partway. The recipient count shows how many emails went out.

segments.description: Segments choose who receives a campaign. Every criterion you set must match; leave one on "Any" to ignore it.
segments.name: Name
segments.tagsHint: Customers with at least one of these tags.
segments.deleteDescription: Campaigns that used it keep their history.

dashboard.error: The ledger summary couldn't be loaded.
dashboard.chartHint: From posted journal entries, in IQD.
dashboard.scenarioHint: Showing {scenario} entries only. They never mix with the actual books.

journal.newHint: Every entry needs at least two lines, and debits must equal credits.
journal.referenceHint: Optional: an invoice, receipt or payment reference.
journal.bookedIn: Booked in {currency} at {rate} IQD per unit
journal.scenarioHint: Forecast and budget entries are kept apart from the actual books.
journal.currencyHint: Amounts are entered in IQD. For a transaction in another currency, enter its code (e.g. USD) and the rate used.
journal.currencyForeignHint: Enter the line amounts already converted to IQD. The {currency} currency and rate are kept with the entry for reference.
journal.dimensionsHint: Optional tags for reports, e.g. product_line = plus or branch = mansour.

accounts.description: Posted entries keep their accounts; deactivate an account to stop using it.
accounts.name: Name

payroll.description: Planned, open and filled positions. Salaries are monthly, in IQD; raises apply on each anniversary of the start date.
payroll.projectionHint: Positions count from their start date; ended positions are left out.

equity.tableHint: Ownership is each holder's share of all shares. Values use the round's price per share, in the round's currency.
equity.roundsHint: Amounts are in the round's currency (e.g. USD).
equity.deleteRoundDescription: Its shareholders stay, without a round.

settings.description: Settings used across the finance section.
settings.fiscalYearHint: "This year" figures on the overview count from the start of the fiscal year.
settings.baseCurrencyHint: Ledger amounts are recorded in this currency (IQD).

assets.scheduleHint: Straight-line over each asset's useful life, counting whole months from purchase (to disposal). Amounts in IQD.
assets.error: The depreciation schedule couldn't be loaded.
assets.empty: No assets bought by this date.
assets.name: Asset
assets.listHint: Cost and salvage value in IQD. Set a disposal date when an asset is sold or written off; depreciation stops then.
assets.deleteDescription: Remove the asset from the register. To keep its history, set a disposal date instead.

publish.label: Publishing
publish.scheduleHint: Baghdad time. It goes live automatically.

events.title: Event
events.publishedHint: Visible on the website and open for RSVPs until it starts.

journal.title: Title
journal.pdfHint: Required before publishing. Up to 50 MB.

submissions.error: The review queue couldn't be loaded.
submissions.blindHint: Blind review: authors are hidden until a submission is accepted or not accepted.
submissions.author: By {name}

review.title: Review
review.author: Author
review.notesHint: Internal; never shown to the author.
review.decisionNoteHint: Shown to the author with the decision.

chats.description: Groups Droid moderates. A ban in one moderated group applies in all of them.
chats.empty: No groups yet. Add the bot to a group as an administrator, then add the group here.
chats.title: Name

faq.description: Droid offers these answers in private chats, in the member's language.

staff.title: Staff
staff.description: Back-office roles. Only superadmins can change them.
staff.addDescription: Find their account by the mobile number or email they sign in with, then choose a role. They must have signed in to The IDEA at least once.
staff.notFound: No account uses that number or email.
staff.revokeDescription: They lose access to the back office immediately. Their customer account stays.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Changes made by staff, recorded automatically.

support.title: Support
support.statusHint: Open: waiting on staff. Pending: waiting on the customer. A staff reply sets pending; a customer reply reopens the ticket.
support.replyHint: The customer sees this reply and gets a notification; the ticket moves to pending.
support.closedReplyHint: This ticket is closed. The customer sees your reply but can't answer on this ticket.
support.noteHint: Only staff see internal notes. The ticket's status doesn't change.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.author: Author
reviews.deleteDescription: The review is removed for good. To take it off the store but keep it, hide it instead.

forbidden.title: The IDEA Design is for staff
forbidden.body: You're signed in, but your account isn't on the staff list. If you should have access, ask an admin to add you in the back office.

meta.title: The IDEA Pass
meta.description: One account for everything at The IDEA: the app, the store, The IDEA Plus and more.

signIn.title: Sign in to The IDEA Pass
signIn.description: Use your mobile number. One account for the app, the store and The IDEA Plus.

signUp.title: Get The IDEA Pass
signUp.description: Sign up with your mobile number. One account for everything at The IDEA.

home.title: Your Pass
home.description: You're signed in to The IDEA Pass. It works across The IDEA Spark, the website and The IDEA Plus.

mfa.title: Authenticator app
mfa.enrollDescription: Protect your account with a second step. Link an authenticator app once; you'll enter its code when a site asks for it. Staff accounts need it for the back office.
mfa.challengeDescription: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for The IDEA.
mfa.stepInstall: Install an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…).
mfa.stepScan: Scan this QR code with it, or enter the setup key below.
mfa.stepCode: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app

errors.invalidCode: That code didn't work. Check the time on your phone and try the newest code.
errors.unavailable: Authenticator apps aren't enabled for this project yet. Ask an administrator to turn on TOTP multi-factor authentication in Supabase.
